title: No excuses! We're keeping the Feast of Tabernacles, rain or shine!
cleanTitle: No excuses! We're keeping the Feast of Tabernacles, rain or shine!
segments: Hey, we out here in Arizona at the Feast
of Tabernacles. God told us three times
a year we must get together and come to
Jerusalem. Since we ain't got Jerusalem,
we coming to Arizona. We rehearsing the
righteous acts of the Lord as Judges 5
and 11 say. And it's the 8-day feast,
you understand? The first day is Sabbath
and the last day is Sabbath. Where we
coming together to build the minds of
the people. We come together to show
them the unity.

got on. I seen some East

It's a beautiful thing that the Lord
